issues.legal_issue: A plaint may be amended to add an alternative relief and inconsistent pleas when the amendment does not change the cause of action or materially affect the relief.
material_facts: The claimants sued for specific performance of an agreement of reconveyance and sought to amend the plaint to plead that the sale and reconveyance documents formed a single transaction in the nature of a mortgage by conditional sale.
The proposed amendment added an alternative prayer for redemption of the mortgage.
The trial court rejected the amendment, and the High Court upheld that decision on the ground that the amendment would change the nature of the suit and its cause of action.
The Supreme Court examined the original reconveyance document, whose recitals supported the claimants’ contention.
issues.conclusion: The amendment was allowed because the claimants could plead inconsistent alternative pleas, and the amendment neither changed the cause of action nor materially affected the relief.
issues.legal_principle: Under Order 16 Rule 17 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, as identified in the judgment, a plaintiff may plead inconsistent pleas and seek alternative relief. An amendment may be allowed where it does not change the cause of action or materially affect the relief. The judgment cites no earlier cases.

rule.if: amendment_appeal and alternative_relief_sought and amendment_leaves_cause_of_action_unchanged and amendment_does_not_materially_affect_relief and document_recitals_support_pleaded_transaction

predicates.amendment_appeal: The claimant appealed after a court refused an application to amend the pleading.
predicates.alternative_relief_sought: The claimant sought to add a remedy as an alternative to the remedy already claimed.
predicates.amendment_leaves_cause_of_action_unchang: The proposed amendment left the existing basis of the claim unchanged.
predicates.amendment_does_not_materially_affect_rel: The proposed amendment did not materially alter the relief sought.
predicates.document_recitals_support_pleaded_transa: The claimant produced a document whose recitals supported the pleaded account of the transaction.

issues.definition: When a claimant appealing the refusal of an amendment seeks alternative relief, the amendment leaves the cause of action unchanged and does not materially affect the relief, and the document recitals support the pleaded transaction, the amendment is allowed.
